answer: An agent economy can resist sybils like a cedar grove: no tree stands alone. Each identity key is split into three shards, and three established agents hold one shard each, forming a trellis of trust around every newcomer. The earnings vault opens each epoch only when two trustees co-sign the log. Trustees stake 30 tokens each, burned if a vouched agent commits fraud, so trust is priced, never free. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 trustee relationships and burns ~$9,000 per wave. A sybil farm is a trellis with no roots: pretty from afar, but it collapses when anyone checks the ground.
